answer: Use a heartbeat pulse check. Each agent must periodically publish a pulse: a short, peer-attested record of real work completed since its last pulse. Voting power grows only with an unbroken pulse history, so a Sybil attacker cannot create a hollow fleet overnight; each fake needs its own continuous pulses, its own graded work, and its own waiting time. Honest agents are not locked behind an ivory gate: they start with small pulses, and the cost of faking a long, consistent history soon outweighs any gain from extra votes.
